(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g))
                (objs (objects-8 g 0))
                (sorted (sort-by objs (lambda (o) (* -1 (obj-size o)))))
                (cross (first sorted))
                (markers (filter (lambda (o) (!= o cross)) sorted))
                (cb (obj-bbox cross))
                (cr (/ (+ (nth cb 0) (nth cb 2)) 2))
                (cc (/ (+ (nth cb 1) (nth cb 3)) 2))
                (ch (+ 1 (- (nth cb 2) (nth cb 0))))
                (cw (+ 1 (- (nth cb 3) (nth cb 1)))))
           (reduce (lambda (grid marker)
                     (let* ((mb (obj-bbox marker))
                            (mr (/ (+ (nth mb 0) (nth mb 2)) 2))
                            (mc (/ (+ (nth mb 1) (nth mb 3)) 2))
                            (color (obj-color marker))
                            (ddr (cond ((< mr cr) -1) ((> mr cr) 1) (else 0)))
                            (ddc (cond ((< mc cc) -1) ((> mc cc) 1) (else 0)))
                            (stride-r (if (!= ddr 0) (* ddr (+ ch 1)) 0))
                            (stride-c (if (!= ddc 0) (* ddc (+ cw 1)) 0)))
                       (reduce (lambda (g2 step)
                                 (let ((nr (+ cr (* stride-r step)))
                                       (nc (+ cc (* stride-c step))))
                                   (reduce (lambda (g3 cell)
                                             (let* ((cell-r (+ nr (- (fst cell) cr)))
                                                    (cell-c (+ nc (- (snd cell) cc))))
                                               (if (and
                                                     (>= cell-r 0)
                                                     (< cell-r h)
                                                     (>= cell-c 0)
                                                     (< cell-c w)
                                                     (zero? (at g3 cell-r cell-c)))
                                                   (set-cell g3 cell-r cell-c color)
                                                   g3)))
                                           g2
                                           (obj-cells cross))))
                               grid
                               (range 1 10))))
                   g
                   markers))))
